title: Verify: transitionTo ignored after SHUTDOWN while other subscribers stay active
summary: Unit tests for the SHUTDOWN release of transitionTo
description: Mirror tests/bootScenePlayAnimationShutdown.test.ts for transitionTo with Phaser mocked.
acceptance_criteria: No fadeOut or scene.start after shutdown
A pre-existing subscriber still receives transitionTo

steps.action: Create the file with the phaser mock from bootSceneTransition.test.ts; subscribe otherHandler = vi.fn() via reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo', ...) before new BootScene().create(); add a runShutdown helper that finds the 'shutdown' callback in boot.events.once.mock.calls and calls it
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionShutdown.test.ts

steps.symbol: it('ignores transitionTo after the SHUTDOWN callback runs')
steps.action: Call runShutdown(), emit transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' }, assert fadeOut and scene.start were not called
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionShutdown.test.ts -t 'ignores transitionTo'

steps.symbol: it('keeps other transitionTo subscribers active after shutdown')
steps.action: Call runShutdown(), emit transitionTo with payload { sceneId: 'library' }, assert otherHandler toHaveBeenCalledWith(payload) and fadeOut not called
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionShutdown.test.ts -t 'other transitionTo subscribers'
